answer: The test I would set is Last maker riding boot seal pegged at the finishing shop, because each riding boot is a measured shoe yield plus a guild signature, so a farm must is the one thing a farm cannot print overnight. Scale is not a discount here: 454 proofs still cost 49032 POA, one 108 POA proof at a time. The whisper is the farm's shopping list, the nadir is its receipt, and the haven is the one item the shop never sold. A farm's business is volume; this epoch's business is proof, and the two do not mix.
